# Moon Dog

> Free, citation-backed calculators and plain-English guides for makers and hobbyists — home canning (per-food USDA times), hydroponics, soap making, cold plunge, aquarium and pond chemistry, sous vide, mushroom growing, knife heat-treat and more. Each topic pairs a focused calculator with guides citing primary sources (USDA/NCHFP, university extension, IFOS, peer-reviewed literature). Companion iOS apps exist but every guide is free to read on the web.
